class.name: SceneDoor
class.brief_description: A linked load door that triggers [SceneManager] travel.
class.description: Place a [SceneDoor] as an [Area] with a collision shape in a doorway. When a body in [member body_filter] enters (mode [constant ON_BODY_ENTER]), or when [method activate] is called (mode [constant ON_INTERACT]), it calls [method SceneManager.travel_to] with [member target_scene] and [member target_spawn]. Triggers are ignored while [SceneManager] is already travelling, during [member cooldown], and after the first fire if [member one_shot] is set. The node is inert in the editor.

method.name: activate
method.description: Triggers the door regardless of [member trigger_mode] and [member body_filter], for use by an interaction system. Still subject to the cooldown / travelling / one-shot guards.

members.member: Group the entering body must belong to. Empty means any body.
Seconds after a trigger before the door can fire again.
If set, the door fires only once per run.
[member SceneSpawnPoint.spawn_id] in the destination scene to place the player at. Empty uses the entry's default spawn.

constants.constant: Fires when a body in [member body_filter] enters the Area.
